resume: Felucca where randomization becomes an invocation: each new sound calls one of the 30 demons of the Ars Goetia, whose sigil takes the screen and whose rank decides how violent the change is. A Knight barely touches the sound, a King remakes it entirely.

commandes.role: Held, its black keys drive the ritual: black key 1 (RIT) turns it on or off on the track, black key 3 (SUM) summons a demon.
Held, undoes and returns to the sound from before the invocations.
With EDIT held: black key 1 (RIT) turns the ritual on or off, black key 3 (SUM) summons.

gestes: EDIT held + black key 3 (SUM): summons a demon; on HOME, everything is drawn (FM6 patch, ENV, LFO, FX), on an ENV, LFO or FX page only its family is.
EDIT held + black key 1 (RIT): turns the track's ritual on or off.
SAVE held: undoes back to the sound from before.
Turning a knob on an ENV, LFO, FX or FM6 operator page, ritual on: each notch is a new invocation.

modes.texte: Set per track, on at every power-up. The demon's sigil replaces the graphs. With the ritual off, the FM-1 is normal again for the track.

a_savoir: The shared effects pages (DLY, REVERB, CHORUS) serve all tracks: SAVE undoes nothing there.
On FM6, the ENV area changes nothing in what you hear: summon the operators instead.
